findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router is active and configured at port 8891, but call_log_exists is false at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router service creates and logs requests to call_log.jsonl properly so request telemetry and latency tracking are captured.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model router latency, call patterns, and failure telemetry.

findings.title: Emergency alert provider calls external APIs directly instead of through model router

evidence.observation: Emergency alert provider directly invokes call_gemini and call_mistral via environment API keys rather than utilizing the model router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM queries through the centralized model router endpoint.

findings.expected_benefit: Enforces unified model routing, retry semantics, fallback logic, and centralized telemetry tracking.
